commit.message:
fix(lint): clean the fused-RoPE additions (#8)

The rope-fused PR landed with 3 ruff errors (unsorted imports, two
zip() without strict=) that turned the lint job red. Add strict=True
(the axis lists are same-length by construction), sort the imports,
and clear the ty findings the same code introduced: list literals for
mx.stack, direct guarded slices instead of Optional locals (ty baseline
46 -> 42; the type job stays non-blocking).


Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_011tPfYSaviKaAqHfcAptXAv

fix(lint): clean the fused-RoPE additions (#8)

The rope-fused PR landed with 3 ruff errors (unsorted imports, two
zip() without strict=) that turned the lint job red. Add strict=True
(the axis lists are same-length by construction), sort the imports,
and clear the ty findings the same code introduced: list literals for
mx.stack, direct guarded slices instead of Optional locals (ty baseline
46 -> 42; the type job stays non-blocking).
